verdict.rationale: The CLI ships `skills init` to scaffold a new SKILL.md template and references a `skill-creator` skill in vercel-labs/agent-skills that can be installed, plus a separate `skills-ref validate` tool to check a skill's format before packaging. However, there's no first-party documentation showing an end-to-end guided workflow for writing, iteratively improving, and packaging skills — the skill-creator's actual guidance content is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented content/behavior of the skill-creator meta-skill, evidence of an 'improve/review' step, and integration between init/validate/creator into one cohesive authoring flow.
